jobs.title: Operations Coordinator (In Store)
jobs.description:
### **Position**

**Overview:**

Tiffany \& Co… the name instills images of Beauty, Romance and the iconic Blue Box. It is a Symbol of Excellence. For 175 years, Tiffany has created a legacy of exquisite designs and romantic ideals. Tiffany \& Co.'s rich heritage of celebrated artists, historic milestones and magnificent jewelry creates the foundation from which our employees build upon each day. Tiffany employees are passionate, kind and professionally committed. We hold ourselves and our co\-workers to very high standards. We continually educate ourselves about new merchandise collections, cultures and the evolving luxury market. Our respect and love for the brand creates a workplace like no other.  



Tiffany employees honor every special moment in our customer's lives and every unique gift that commemorates their milestones. This differentiating factor, known as the Tiffany Experience ( *Creating Connections, Providing Personalized Experiences and Honoring the Tiffany Legacy)* is never compromised…. and it never will be.  



We expect our employees to deliver the Tiffany Experience to each and every customer and Tiffany is committed to creating an organization that recognizes and rewards excellence in service of this promise. For us, it is a dream to be associated with a company that is forever aligned with exquisite craftsmanship, timeless design and a dedicated commitment to corporate sustainability.  



**Responsibilities:**

The Operations Coordinator takes the lead by performing all back of house operations in a Tiffany store. The Coordinator has a passion for providing excellent client service and partners with store leadership on key initiatives which supports the team and drives sales goals. The Coordinator is a key holder who acts as a manager on duty when a manager is unavailable. Duties include coordinating order fulfillment, managing inventory, coordinating client service activities, and may open and close the store.  



**Sales:** Deepen the relationship with our clients to drive lifetime loyalty and spend. Carry out operations and sales support functions to support the store in consistently achieving or exceeding monthly, quarterly and annual store sales plan. Capture customer data during interactions to cultivate new and existing customers. Act as Guest Experience Manager, key holder, and carryout opening and closing procedures in the absence of a manager. Drive business through key product pillars.  



**Service:** Elevate in store experience by consistently delivering memorable moments. Demonstrate passion as a Tiffany brand ambassador, providing the Tiffany Touch during every client interaction. Demonstrate Client Experience Behaviors identified within the TEI program (Voice of Client Survey). Execute best practices by optimizing hospitality and store amenities to create unique experiences and take action on TEI performance and client feedback. Resolve client and employee concerns utilizing judgment and thorough knowledge of policy, procedure and practice.  



**Operational Excellence:** Provide exceptional operational support to drive sales and service. Execute daily tasks such as order fulfillment, shipping, receiving and replenishment, cleaning jewelry, transferring merchandise, taking in jewelry repairs and cleaning merchandise, following company operational policies and procedures. Ensure compliance with all internal control procedures and maintain inventory accuracy. Partner and communicate effectively with Sales Professionals, Management and clients to respond and follow up to requests quickly and accurately. Support Company operations efficiency objectives by ensuring all activities maximize productivity and by providing feedback on process changes through appropriate channels. Assist management in coordinating work and coaching team members to improve performance when acting as manager on duty. Takes the lead, partnering with the operations professional to ensure operational excellence in all tasks.  



**Qualifications:**

Required Qualifications:


* 2\-3 years of prior retail experience in retail operations with comprehensive knowledge of merchandising, client service, administration and shipping.
* Strong Analytical skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Word and Excel.
* Ability to work retail store hours as necessary, including nights, weekends and holidays.
* Organized and detail oriented.
* Flexibility to perform different tasks based on day\-to\-day business needs.
* Must have authorization to work in the United States or in the country where the position is based.

Preferred Qualifications:


* A college/university degree.
Graduate Gemologist degree or previous Gemological Institute of America (GIA) course work.  
* 

Illinois Wage Transparency Disclosure\-$24\.65\-$29\.00


***TIFFANY \& CO.***
**MAISON**
-------------------------------

Founded in 1837 by Charles Lewis Tiffany in New York City, Tiffany \& Co. is one of the world’s most prestigious houses for jewelry and accessories. Love has been the driving force of Tiffany \& Co. since its inception, uniting the jeweler’s core values of inventiveness, craft and joy in designs that endure across generations.
  

As a global pioneer in the art of fine jewelry, Tiffany has spent almost two centuries perfecting its craft and setting benchmarks within the industry. It is through this unwavering vow to excellence and expertise, to heritage and innovation, to optimism and possibility that Tiffany continues its legacy, creating designs that inspire people to express and celebrate the many facets of love.

**Program Coordinator**

**Read Aloud Mentoring Program (RAMP)** 

**Serving Vine Street Elementary, Los Angeles, CA 90038**

**Location:** Vine Street Elementary School, 955 Vine Street, Los Angeles, CA 90038

**Schedule and Hours:** Up to 5 days a week, Monday through Friday. Hours will vary between approximately 10:45 am and 12:45 pm from September through June. Training and onboarding for the position will begin upon hire in August. Some availability is required outside of these times for data entry, communications, and meetings as needed. Up to 10 hours per week.

**Position Overview**

Do you believe every child deserves a caring mentor and the opportunity to fall in love with reading? Join Read to a Child as a Program Coordinator, where you'll play a vital role in bringing our Read Aloud Mentoring Program (RAMP) to life. By coordinating volunteers, partnering with schools, and supporting meaningful mentor\-student relationships, you'll help elementary students build confidence, improve literacy skills, and experience the power of reading.

Our Read Aloud Mentoring Program (RAMP) pairs volunteer mentors with Kindergarten through 4th grade students for a fun and rewarding weekly read\-aloud session during the school day. As the Program Coordinator, you'll be the heart of the program at your assigned school, ensuring every mentor, student, and school partner enjoys a positive, well\-organized, and impactful experience.

In this role, you'll coordinate the day\-to\-day operations of the program, build strong relationships with volunteers and school staff, manage scheduling and program records, and help create an environment where students can thrive.

**The current open Program Coordinator role is an on\-site position working in schools directly with students. Successful candidates must be comfortable working in an in\-school environment and in keeping with all safety protocols required by the school, as well as be comfortable/confident working with technology.**

This role is extremely important to the program’s function and success and will be an integral part of a fun and collaborative team! Our Program Coordinators are truly the face of our program and make a real difference in the lives of our students every year.

If you're organized, people\-focused, and passionate about making a difference in your community, we'd love to hear from you!

**Specific Job Responsibilities Will Include All or Some of the Following (will vary by Region \& School/Site)**

1\. Program Operations \& Coordination

* Ensure smooth program start\-up, including school partnership logistics (relationships, space, scheduling, absences, referrals, permissions, matching pairs)
* Facilitate and monitor reading sessions, which may be in\-person and/or virtual, to ensure smooth operation of program
* If coordinating on\-site, ensure hygiene/safety guidelines are followed and rooms are left clean and orderly
* Provide volunteers with book ideas; maintain an organized and inviting book cart (on\-site programs only)
* Facilitate other activities or tasks as requested (e.g., supporting other schools)

2\. Communication \& Relationship Management

* Communicate regularly with supervisor
* Communicate with volunteer mentors: provide program updates, notify of student absences, and share schedule changes
* Notify students, teachers, and potentially parents/guardians of volunteer mentor cancellations or schedule changes
* Provide ongoing support and guidance to volunteer mentors, including general and case\-specific advice (with supervisor input)

3\. Data Management \& Administrative Tasks

* Document reading session attendance and participant information changes in the database
* Collect mid\-year and year\-end surveys/assessments from mentors, students, and teachers
* Submit timesheets accurately and on time

4\. Volunteer Engagement \& Support

* Support volunteer recruitment efforts
* Assist students in making thank\-you cards for mentors
* Plan and implement year\-end celebration (as applicable)

5\. Training \& Professional Development

* Attend required Program Coordinator training sessions and meetings
* Participate in performance evaluation and goal\-setting process
* Interested Program Coordinators may be able to take on some Program Assistant roles (virtually or in person) at other schools

**Essential Job Duties For In\-Person Positions** This person working in this position will be in a school setting. It involves constant movement throughout the building and designated session areas, guiding students to their reading session. Depending on the school, this may require occasionally ascending/descending stairs. It also requires frequent positioning of books and/or program materials of various weights and sizes on a rolling book cart, as well as rolling the book cart to/from various locations within the school.

**Key Qualifications**

* Commitment to Read to a Child’s mission, viability and growth
* Experience working with young children
* Enthusiastic about children’s books, willingness to become familiar with the Read to a Child book collection
* Preferred \- Experience managing volunteers
* Communicates well in person, virtually, on the telephone \& via email
* Commitment to actively and continuously working toward achieving the organization’s Diversity, Equity and Inclusion goals
* Extremely organized and adept at successfully managing multiple projects simultaneously and prioritizing according to the organization’s strategic plan \-\- with flexibility and a positive attitude
* Comfortable working with and hosting group video conference platforms (eg: Zoom and/or Google Meets)
* Proficiency working with various technological platforms: E\-mail, Google Drive, word processing, spreadsheets, E\-book sources, and some data entry

FutureSight is seeking a Co\-Founder \& CEO to lead Omnex, an AI\-native operating system for multi\-channel ecommerce sellers, currently in build at our studio. This is a co\-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

The opportunity sits within a global ecommerce market exceeding $1 trillion in annual GMV, where millions of sellers increasingly operate across multiple channels but lack any unified operational intelligence layer.

Omnex replaces this fragmented workflow with an autonomous, multi\-agent AI workforce. Instead of giving sellers another dashboard, Omnex continuously understands the business, reasons across every sales channel, and proactively executes operational decisions—from optimizing pricing and inventory to managing advertising, forecasting demand, and coordinating customer support. FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co\-creates world\-class software companies with values\-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

### **What you'll own**

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Hi! We're Forerunner.**
=========================


Stronger, more resilient communities are built by the people inside government and regulated industries who keep critical infrastructure running. But they're working against real headwinds: fragmented data, field crews without the right tools, and high\-stakes decisions made without a complete picture.


Forerunner exists to fix that. We build intelligent software that connects the systems these agencies and firms already rely on, fills the gaps those systems can't, and turns fragmented information into decisions and actions that reduce liability, surface revenue, and prevent small problems from becoming emergencies.

**About the role**
------------------


As a Customer Success Manager, you will own the ongoing success of a full book of business — from onboarding through renewal — ensuring every account realizes measurable value from Forerunner and grows into a durable, trusted partnership. You'll work at the intersection of relationship management, product adoption, and account growth, partnering with Sales, Product, and Engineering to keep outcomes on track.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Customer Health \& Retention**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to your accounts, understanding their workflows and goals well enough to guide them toward renewal.
* Own customer health across your portfolio, using data and regular check\-ins to catch risk early and keep accounts moving toward measurable outcomes.
* Guide customers through public\-sector and regulated\-industry decision cycles with patience and clear communication.

### **Product Adoption**

* Partner with the Deployment Specialist to take a clean handoff at go\-live and carry momentum into the ongoing success phase.
* Drive adoption through user communications, customized in\-app onboarding, and continued learning so customers get full value from their investment.
* Configure customer environments and settings as needs evolve, using both the product front end and Forerunner's internal tools.

### **Account Growth**

* Identify and pursue expansion opportunities — upsells, add\-ons, and cross\-sells — within your accounts.
* Partner with Sales and leadership to build the case for expansion and drive it to close.

### **Cross\-Functional Partnership**

* Share customer feedback, ideas, and concerns with Product and Engineering to inform the roadmap.
* Evangelize customer success stories across your accounts to help build the broader Forerunner community.

### **Team Building**

* Contribute to the ongoing development of CS policy, process, and playbooks as an early member of a growing team.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 4\-6 years of professional experience in customer success, account management, or client services, with a track record of managing end\-to\-end renewals and proactively uncovering expansion opportunities within a portfolio.
* Experience serving government agencies or regulated industries — GovTech, floodplain management or flood insurance, GIS/mapping, or public\-sector project management are all relevant backgrounds, though not required.
* Comfortable managing complex, public\-sector relationships and decision cycles; experience partnering with government clients or supporting complex public\-sector workflows is a plus.
* An excellent, empathetic communicator — you're often a customer's first point of contact, and building trust matters in our space.
* Detail\-oriented and committed to quality, with genuine enthusiasm for creating customer value.
* Comfortable with a high degree of ambiguity — able to prioritize independently and take on responsibility as the team grows.
* Experience supporting SaaS software is preferred but not required.

**You'll thrive in this role if you...**
----------------------------------------

* Believe in delivering measurable outcomes to customers, not just checking off tasks.
* Enjoy being a trusted point of contact and building long\-term relationships.
* Are comfortable balancing day\-to\-day account management with longer\-term account strategy.

**Our team has a lot to offer.**
--------------------------------


Forerunner is an early\-stage company with an interdisciplinary team. We are motivated by seemingly intractable problems and work hard to support one another.

* **We're mission\-driven.** Our mission orients our business strategy and pushes us to work with a sense of urgency. We're in the weeds — our entire team spends time engaging with our partners in the field to better understand the real\-world problems they face.
* **We're a small team.** As a member of our growing team, you will quickly become an invaluable part of our organization and have a meaningful impact on our business and technical direction. We welcome unique perspectives and backgrounds. Your opinion matters and we hope you'll share it.
* **We build each other up.** A team works best when its members are equipped with the tools to tackle the problems they're facing. Forerunner strives to provide meaningful feedback and learning opportunities to help all our team members grow.
* **We value in\-person connection**, so we keep offices in NYC, San Francisco, and Portland, ME. Roles can be hybrid or fully remote, depending on the work.
* **We want you to be happy and healthy.** Forerunner offers competitive compensation, health/vision/dental coverage, a 401k plan, and one expensed lunch per week. We also have a quarterly wellness reimbursement so you can define what "health" means to you.
* **The salary range for this position** is $90,000\-$120,000 with an OTE of $105,000\-$135,000\. This posting may span more than one career level. Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors, including an individual's skills, experience, and qualifications.


Forerunner is an equal opportunity employer committed to embracing diversity and the perspectives of individuals from all backgrounds.

new_jobs.description:
### **The Opportunity**


FutureSight is seeking a Co\-Founder \& CEO to lead Omnex, an AI\-native operating system for multi\-channel ecommerce sellers, currently in build at our studio. This is a co\-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.


Today's e\-commerce businesses run on fragmented software and manual coordination. Sellers operating across Amazon, Shopify, eBay, Walmart, and other channels constantly switch between dashboards, reconcile conflicting data, and make hundreds of operational decisions every day across pricing, inventory, advertising, fulfillment, and customer support.


The opportunity sits within a global ecommerce market exceeding $1 trillion in annual GMV, where millions of sellers increasingly operate across multiple channels but lack any unified operational intelligence layer.

### **Market Context**


Omnex replaces this fragmented workflow with an autonomous, multi\-agent AI workforce. Instead of giving sellers another dashboard, Omnex continuously understands the business, reasons across every sales channel, and proactively executes operational decisions—from optimizing pricing and inventory to managing advertising, forecasting demand, and coordinating customer support. Every AI agent shares the same business context, learns from outcomes, and works together to optimize the business as a whole.

### **About FutureSight**


FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co\-creates world\-class software companies with values\-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.


You’ll co\-create with a proven studio team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E\&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co\-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow\-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0\-to\-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

### **The Partnership**

* Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception
* Pre\-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow\-on funding
* Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one
* Investor and advisor network across logistics, vertical AI, and early\-stage capital markets
* A true co\-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight's cross\-functional team as your partner

### **What you'll own**


As Co\-Founder \& CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

* Strategy — Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning
* Customer Development — Lead pilots with ecommerce sellers, convert them to paid engagements, and build the go\-to\-market motion
* Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback
* Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction
* Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

### **Co\-Founder Profile**

* Previous founding experience at a venture\-backed company
* Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS go\-to\-market, including sales and customer engagement
* Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital
* Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent
* Clear\-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co\-founding a venture\-backed company
* Direct experience in ecommerce — operated a multi\-channel business, sold software into this market, or built tools for ecommerce sellers at scale
* Network within the ecommerce seller community (Amazon sellers, Shopify operators, 3PL partners)

### **How to Apply**


Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.


FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Hi! We're Forerunner.**
=========================


Stronger, more resilient communities are built by the people inside government and regulated industries who keep critical infrastructure running. But they're working against real headwinds: fragmented data, field crews without the right tools, and high\-stakes decisions made without a complete picture.


Forerunner exists to fix that. We build intelligent software that connects the systems these agencies and firms already rely on, fills the gaps those systems can't, and turns fragmented information into decisions and actions that reduce liability, surface revenue, and prevent small problems from becoming emergencies.

**About the role**
------------------


As a Customer Success Manager, you will own the ongoing success of a full book of business — from onboarding through renewal — ensuring every account realizes measurable value from Forerunner and grows into a durable, trusted partnership. You'll work at the intersection of relationship management, product adoption, and account growth, partnering with Sales, Product, and Engineering to keep outcomes on track.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Customer Health \& Retention**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to your accounts, understanding their workflows and goals well enough to guide them toward renewal.
* Own customer health across your portfolio, using data and regular check\-ins to catch risk early and keep accounts moving toward measurable outcomes.
* Guide customers through public\-sector and regulated\-industry decision cycles with patience and clear communication.

### **Product Adoption**

* Partner with the Deployment Specialist to take a clean handoff at go\-live and carry momentum into the ongoing success phase.
* Drive adoption through user communications, customized in\-app onboarding, and continued learning so customers get full value from their investment.
* Configure customer environments and settings as needs evolve, using both the product front end and Forerunner's internal tools.

### **Account Growth**

* Identify and pursue expansion opportunities — upsells, add\-ons, and cross\-sells — within your accounts.
* Partner with Sales and leadership to build the case for expansion and drive it to close.

### **Cross\-Functional Partnership**

* Share customer feedback, ideas, and concerns with Product and Engineering to inform the roadmap.
* Evangelize customer success stories across your accounts to help build the broader Forerunner community.

### **Team Building**

* Contribute to the ongoing development of CS policy, process, and playbooks as an early member of a growing team.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 4\-6 years of professional experience in customer success, account management, or client services, with a track record of managing end\-to\-end renewals and proactively uncovering expansion opportunities within a portfolio.
* Experience serving government agencies or regulated industries — GovTech, floodplain management or flood insurance, GIS/mapping, or public\-sector project management are all relevant backgrounds, though not required.
* Comfortable managing complex, public\-sector relationships and decision cycles; experience partnering with government clients or supporting complex public\-sector workflows is a plus.
* An excellent, empathetic communicator — you're often a customer's first point of contact, and building trust matters in our space.
* Detail\-oriented and committed to quality, with genuine enthusiasm for creating customer value.
* Comfortable with a high degree of ambiguity — able to prioritize independently and take on responsibility as the team grows.
* Experience supporting SaaS software is preferred but not required.

**You'll thrive in this role if you...**
----------------------------------------

* Believe in delivering measurable outcomes to customers, not just checking off tasks.
* Enjoy being a trusted point of contact and building long\-term relationships.
* Are comfortable balancing day\-to\-day account management with longer\-term account strategy.

**Our team has a lot to offer.**
--------------------------------


Forerunner is an early\-stage company with an interdisciplinary team. We are motivated by seemingly intractable problems and work hard to support one another.

* **We're mission\-driven.** Our mission orients our business strategy and pushes us to work with a sense of urgency. We're in the weeds — our entire team spends time engaging with our partners in the field to better understand the real\-world problems they face.
* **We're a small team.** As a member of our growing team, you will quickly become an invaluable part of our organization and have a meaningful impact on our business and technical direction. We welcome unique perspectives and backgrounds. Your opinion matters and we hope you'll share it.
* **We build each other up.** A team works best when its members are equipped with the tools to tackle the problems they're facing. Forerunner strives to provide meaningful feedback and learning opportunities to help all our team members grow.
* **We value in\-person connection**, so we keep offices in NYC, San Francisco, and Portland, ME. Roles can be hybrid or fully remote, depending on the work.
* **We want you to be happy and healthy.** Forerunner offers competitive compensation, health/vision/dental coverage, a 401k plan, and one expensed lunch per week. We also have a quarterly wellness reimbursement so you can define what "health" means to you.
* **The salary range for this position** is $90,000\-$120,000 with an OTE of $105,000\-$135,000\. This posting may span more than one career level. Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors, including an individual's skills, experience, and qualifications.


Forerunner is an equal opportunity employer committed to embracing diversity and the perspectives of individuals from all backgrounds.

**Field Sales Manager — Recharge Station Placement**

**Manhattan, New York City**

**Location:** Manhattan, NYC  
**Format:** Full\-time, on\-site / field\-based  
**Start:** ASAP

**About the Company**  
**Recharge City** is one of NYC’s fastest\-growing **portable power bank rental networks,** already partnering with restaurants, bars, retail stores, entertainment venues, and other high\-traffic businesses across the city.

**Field Sales Manager — Recharge Station Placement**

**Manhattan, New York City**

**Location:** Manhattan, NYC**Format:** Full\-time, on\-site / field\-based**Start:** ASAP**Openings:** 10

**About the Role**

We are looking for strong **field sales professionals** to expand our network of station placements across Manhattan.

This is a highly active, street\-level sales role. You will spend a significant part of your working day **walking your assigned territory, visiting businesses in person, introducing yourself to owners and managers, and negotiating station placements face\-to\-face.**

This is **not a desk\-based sales position** and not an inbound sales role. You are expected to actively create your own pipeline, approach businesses directly, and consistently generate new opportunities.

The strongest candidates already have experience with **door\-to\-door or field B2B sales in New York City** and know how to get access to decision\-makers.

An existing network or contact list of NYC businesses is a major advantage.

**What You Will Do**

* Walk your assigned territory in Manhattan and actively prospect businesses in person.
* Enter stores, restaurants, gyms, salons, hotels, offices, and other commercial locations without waiting for inbound leads.
* Identify and reach owners, general managers, operators, and other decision\-makers.
* Conduct cold face\-to\-face outreach and introduce the station placement opportunity.
* Build your own pipeline through both direct street prospecting and open\-source research.
* Schedule and conduct follow\-up meetings when needed.
* Negotiate placement terms and close agreements.
* Agree on the installation of stations with business partners.
* Transfer confirmed installation details to the operations team.
* Maintain regular follow\-up with prospects until the deal is closed.
* Develop long\-term relationships with business owners and local operators.
* Maintain accurate reporting on visits, leads, negotiations, closed placements, and installations.
* Meet monthly installation and rental targets.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Proven experience in **field sales, door\-to\-door sales, outside sales, or B2B business development**.
* Strong preference for candidates with sales experience specifically in **New York City**.
* Comfortable approaching businesses cold and starting conversations with people you have never met.
* Able to walk extensively around Manhattan and visit a high number of locations every day.
* Strong ability to identify and reach decision\-makers.
* Proven ability to negotiate and close deals.
* Persistent and comfortable hearing “no” repeatedly while continuing to prospect.
* Self\-driven and able to work independently without constant supervision.
* Confident face\-to\-face communication.
* Strong spoken English.
* Existing NYC business contacts are a significant advantage.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

**Compensation**

Compensation is performance\-based and depends on your monthly results.

**Junior Field Sales Manager$3,500/month base \+ KPI bonus.** Minimum: **5 installations per month.** Up to **20 rentals**

**Mid\-Level Field Sales Manager$6,000/month base \+ KPI bonus.** Minimum: **8 installations per month. 40\+ rentals**

**Senior Field Sales Manager$8,000/month base \+ KPI bonus.** Minimum: **10 installations per month 60\+ rentals**

**Senior Manager — Networks \& Corporate Accounts$10,000/month base \+ KPI bonus.** Target: **200 rentals per month** plus station installations based on business demand.

**Performance Expectations**

Your grade is based on actual monthly performance.

To move to a higher compensation level, you must meet the minimum performance requirements for that grade in the previous month.

If minimum targets are not met, the grade may be adjusted downward.

Cancellations and returns within the first three months are included in performance quality metrics. A cancellation/return rate above **10%** may reduce credited results.

**Career Growth**

Top performers can grow into a **Team Lead** role and take responsibility for a field sales team.

**Important:** this position requires daily active prospecting in the field. You should be comfortable spending hours walking through Manhattan, entering businesses, talking to owners and managers, and creating sales opportunities from scratch.

**Ready to take your sales career to the next level? Join Recharge City and help us power NYC.**

Pay: From $60,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: On the road

**Project Coordinator**


**Position Summary**


* Support the Project/Program Manager in planning, scheduling, and tracking tasks and deliverables across one or more concurrent projects.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date project documentation, including project plans, status reports, meeting minutes, and action item logs.
* Coordinate and schedule project meetings with stakeholders, ensuring agendas, materials, and follow\-up notes are distributed in a timely manner.
* Track project risks, issues, and action items, following up with owners to help ensure timely resolution.

* Support onboarding of new team members and vendors to project processes, tools, and PMO standards.

**Skills:**

**Education:** Typically requires an associates or bachelor's degree (or international equivalent)

new_jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative (Fitness Equipment)
new_jobs.description:
Outside Sales Representative

**Echo Strength** is a rapidly growing fitness equipment brand focused on providing high\-quality, commercial\-grade equipment at competitive prices. As we continue to expand, we are looking for a highly motivated **Outside Sales Representative** to help grow our presence throughout the Carolinas and surrounding areas.

This is a **field\-based sales position** headquartered out of Atlanta, GA. You will not be expected to work from our Atlanta showroom every day. Instead, you will be responsible for getting out into the market, developing relationships, finding new opportunities, and putting Echo Strength equipment in facilities throughout your territory.

The Role

The Outside Sales Representative will be responsible for identifying and developing new commercial sales opportunities across Atlanta and surrounding areas.

You will actively seek out businesses and organizations that need fitness equipment, build relationships with decision\-makers, and guide them through the process of outfitting their facilities with Echo Strength equipment.

This is a **hunter\-style sales role**. We are looking for someone who enjoys getting out in the community, meeting people, making connections, generating leads, and closing business.

What You'll Do

* Prospect for new commercial customers throughout Atlanta and surrounding areas
* Visit commercial gyms, fitness facilities, and businesses to introduce Echo Strength
* Develop relationships with gym owners, facility managers, purchasing managers, contractors, and other decision\-makers
* Identify new construction, renovations, expansions, and equipment\-replacement opportunities
* Generate your own leads through cold calling, networking, in\-person visits, referrals, and community involvement
* Represent Echo Strength at local events, trade shows, fitness events, and community gatherings
* Build a strong network within the local fitness and business community
* Conduct facility visits and help customers determine their equipment needs
* Prepare quotes and proposals and follow opportunities through the sales process
* Maintain consistent communication with prospects and customers
* Work with the Echo Strength team to coordinate equipment orders, deliveries, and installations

Who You'll Sell To

Echo Strength equipment can be used in virtually any facility that needs a gym. Your territory will include opportunities such as:

* Commercial gyms and fitness centers
* Independent gyms and training facilities
* Apartment complexes and residential communities
* Hotels and resorts
* Schools, colleges, and universities
* Fire stations
* Police departments
* Sheriff's departments
* Government facilities
* Corporate wellness centers
* Physical therapy and rehabilitation facilities
* Sports performance facilities
* Country clubs
* And any other organization looking to build or upgrade a fitness facility

What We're Looking For

* Highly motivated and self\-driven
* Comfortable working independently and managing your own schedule
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Confident approaching new people and businesses
* Comfortable with cold calling and in\-person prospecting
* Competitive and goal\-oriented
* Strong follow\-up and organizational skills
* Professional and personable
* Willingness to travel throughout the territory
* Previous sales experience preferred, especially B2B, commercial, fitness, construction, or equipment sales
* Knowledge or experience in the fitness industry is a plus, but not required

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means **getting Echo Strength plugged into the communities you serve**.

We want you to become a familiar face to gym owners, facility managers, contractors, developers, schools, first responders, and other organizations throughout the territory.

The goal isn't simply to wait for leads to come in. It's to **find the opportunities before anyone else does**, build the relationships, and turn those relationships into Echo Strength customers.

Location \& Territory

**Territory:** Atlanta, GA and surrounding areas

This is a **field\-based position**. You will have flexibility to manage your schedule and spend the majority of your time in the field developing business rather than sitting in the office.

Why Echo Strength?

Echo Strength is growing quickly, and this is an opportunity to join the company during an exciting stage of expansion. You'll have the opportunity to help establish and grow Echo Strength's commercial presence throughout the region while working directly with a growing team and brand.

If you're someone who **likes to hunt for business, build relationships, get out in the community, and isn't afraid to knock on doors**, we'd like to hear from you.

Job Types: Full\-time, Part\-time

Pay: From $35,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Employee discount

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Work Location: On the road

The Project Coordinator plays a critical role in supporting the administrative functions required to successfully execute a range of SAP technology\-based projects. new_jobs.description:
**About SLHeeley Tax**

SLHeeley Tax provides individuals and businesses with reliable, affordable tax preparation, bookkeeping, and payroll services. We are a close\-knit, highly collaborative team consisting of our President (who leads tax preparation and bookkeeping), our Vice President (who steers our HR, office management, and administrative operations), an additional tax accountant, 5 bookkeepers, 2 dedicated assistants, and an office coordinator.

**We are currently hiring for an Executive Assistant to the Vice President who will serve as the right hand to the VP.**

We pride ourselves on maintaining a low\-key, laid\-back environment with a relaxed, family feel. Our team is a group of sarcastic and snarky people who genuinely enjoy working together. If you prefer a workplace with absolute corporate stiffness, we are probably not the right fit. But if you have thick skin, appreciate good wit, and want an office where you can truly be yourself, you will fit right in.

**Why Join Us? (The Perks)**

* **The "No\-Fridays" Off\-Season:** Enjoy incredible work\-life balance! From May through December, our office is completely closed on Fridays.
* **Relaxed Dress Code:** We are strictly business\-casual even during the tax rush (jeans paired with a nice top, sweater, or an official SLHeeley sweatshirt).
* **Supportive, Educational Leadership:** Our Vice President is a patient, approachable former teacher who loves to guide, answer questions, and help you learn. Management will gradually add new things to your plate as you master tasks.
* **Growth\-Driven, Adaptive Roles:** Your compensation and daily focus will scale directly with your capabilities. We start pay on the standard end, but as you master tasks and take more off leadership's plate **during your initial 4 months with us, your hourly pay will increase.** These positions are built to adapt over time; as we see which high\-level aspects of the VP’s workload you can confidently take over, we will reshape the roles to lean into your personal strengths and maximize firm efficiency.
* **Annual July 1st Pay Reviews:** Following your initial onboarding period, we provide a yearly pay increase based on overall performance, evaluated every year on **July 1st**.
* **Annual Performance Bonus:** Every February, we award a year\-end bonus based on a percentage of your salary that scales upward based on management evaluation and the unique value you brought to the table throughout the year.
* **Robust Health Benefits:** We offer Blue Cross Blue Shield (BCBS) PPO and HMO health insurance plans, and **we cover 50% of the employee\-only premium.**
* **Generous Paid Time Off:** 10 paid days off for scheduled holiday office closures PLUS approximately 66 hours of individual PTO in your first year.

**Work Schedule \& Seasonal Realities**

Our workflow operates like a pendulum, and you must be comfortable managing both extremes:

* **Tax Season (January – April):** It is busy, high\-energy, and non\-stop. You will work 50–60 hours per week (with guaranteed time\-and\-a\-half overtime pay for all hours over 40\).
* *Standard office hours:* Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM.
* *Extended hours:* The office stays open late on **Mondays and Tuesdays until 8:00 PM**, and is open for **six Saturdays total (4 hours each)**. These shifts are **split across our entire 3\-person administrative team**, keeping your individual schedule fair. Exact schedule is finalized together as an Admin Team in December to give you time to plan for evening and Saturday hours.
* *Note on Leadership Presence:* The VP and President are remote a few days every week, making your role as an on\-site anchor and gatekeeper incredibly important.
* **Off\-Season (Mid\-April – December):** The office shifts to a quiet, slow, and relaxed pace. You will work 35–40 hours per week across a highly flexible Monday through Thursday schedule (Closed Fridays).

**Core Responsibilities**

**Process Improvement \& Workflow Optimization**

* Manage and track the internal flow of tax returns ensuring documents move efficiently from intake through final delivery.
* Manage secure electronic delivery of client tax returns to clients.
* Assist with tax return assembly, including organizing and cleaning up client documents electronically and manually.
* Compile tax return folders, handle year\-end mailings (including organizers), and respond to general inquiries regarding past, current, or pending returns.
* Bring an active eye for optimization; analyze current office flows, brainstorm creative ways to improve existing administrative systems, and help streamline office operations.

**Executive Support \& Client Relations**

* Serve as the primary communication liaison and professional gatekeeper for the VP, communicating with clients on their behalf regarding tax, administrative, or bookkeeping updates.
* Screen incoming correspondence, manage executive calendars, and accurately assess leadership availability.
* Draft memos on business topics and assist with special projects for senior leadership.
* Handle customer complaints with patience, provide appropriate solutions within time limits, and follow up to ensure total client satisfaction.
* Communicate with vendors on behalf of Executive Team.

**Office Operations \& Administration**

* Manage incoming/outgoing client documents via the company portal, send out DocuSign requests, and assist with engagement letters.
* Work directly with our IT department, maintain internal document tracking systems, and monitor the server's back\-up drive.
* Serve as backup support for the Front Desk when necessary.
* Assist with Human Resources (HR) duties.

**Skills and Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 3\+ years of office administration or professional assistant experience required. Experience working within a CPA, accounting, or tax firm is highly preferred.

new_jobs.title: Customer Account Manager - Schaumburg, IL
new_jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**What is a Customer Account Manager (CAM)?**


At Advance Auto Parts, a Customer Account Manager (CAM) sells or oversees the selling of automotive products for repair or distribution to automotive repair shops and other commercial businesses. The CAM must be committed to inspiring our team, helping our customers succeed, and growing the business and profitability with integrity.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities**

* Work with District Leaders, General Managers and other key personnel to achieve all agreed upon goals for assigned accounts
* Implement new Commercial Sales programs, as well as support current programs
* Visit assigned accounts, making sales calls and developing approaches that best position products, services, or ideas; identify and meet the needs of commercial customers. Maintain database of account sales call activity, etc.
* Proactively communicate with Store Team on a regular basis to ensure that customer expectations concerning product availability, accuracy, and delivery timelines are realistic and being met
* Provide feedback and input to business partners regarding competitive information, merchandising suggestions, and other services to strengthen the market position of the company
* Partner in the development and retention of Commercial Parts Pros to support the Advance plan for internal growth and career opportunities
* Demonstrate an eagerness to be a team player and assist in other functions as assigned by Region and Area leaders and as needed, including, but not limited to: cleaning, organizing, stocking, operating POS equipment, truck loading/unloading, etc.

**Essential Job Skills Necessary for Success as a CAM**

* Working knowledge of Advance products and services and the ability to market those products and services to meet customer need
* Working knowledge of the APAL system, including Inventory Management and processing of Commercial account paperwork
* Working knowledge of automotive systems and traditional automotive aftermarket
* Speak and write English (Spanish a plus); communicate effectively and build strong relationships with customers, peers and upper management
* Strong presentation and verbal and written communications skills, including ability to write reports, business correspondence and procedural manuals
* Use Microsoft software effectively (Word, Excel required – PowerPoint preferred)
* Calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, percentages, sales increases, and gross profit percent
* Ability to review and analyze business reports, such as profit and loss statement (P\&L)
* Think strategically, analyze issues and options, and effectively manage and facilitate change
* Ability to work an assortment of days, evenings, and weekends as needed
* Ability to travel overnight occasionally

**Prior Experiences that Set a CAM up for Success**

* Proven sales track record with 3\-5 years related selling experience.

**Education**

* High School diploma or general education degree (GED)
* Associate’s degree or equivalent from a two\-year college or technical school preferred

**Certificates, Licenses, Registrations**

* Must have a valid driver's license and be fleet safety certified.
* ASE certification preferred, but not required

**Physical Demands**


The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a Team Member to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


While performing the duties of this job, the Team Member is frequently required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and talk or hear. The Team Member must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100


pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

**Work Environment**


The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those a Team Member encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


While performing the duties of this job, the Team Member is occasionally exposed to wet and/or humid conditions; moving mechanical parts; high, precarious places; toxic or caustic chemicals; outside weather conditions; extreme cold; extreme heat; risk of electrical shock; explosives; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

*Position is eligible for sales commission based on individual or store performance.*


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class. We comply with all applicable federal, state, and local laws.
**Compensation Range**


The good faith estimate for this role is between 51,500\.00 USD and 63,100\.00 USD salary for a new team member.
The rate offered depends on a number of factors, including geographic location, experience in retail, automotive knowledge, education, leadership roles, and other skillsets ideal for this position and shift differential (if applicable).

**Benefits:** Advance Auto Parts offers a comprehensive health and wellness benefits program to improve the way of life for our Team Members and those who mean the most to them: their families. Find out more by visiting:


Advance Auto Parts\-Home

https://jobs.advanceautoparts.com/us/en/disclosures

new_jobs.title: Operations Coordinator (In Store)
new_jobs.description:
### **Position**

**Overview:**

Tiffany \& Co… the name instills images of Beauty, Romance and the iconic Blue Box. It is a Symbol of Excellence. For 175 years, Tiffany has created a legacy of exquisite designs and romantic ideals. Tiffany \& Co.'s rich heritage of celebrated artists, historic milestones and magnificent jewelry creates the foundation from which our employees build upon each day. Tiffany employees are passionate, kind and professionally committed. We hold ourselves and our co\-workers to very high standards. We continually educate ourselves about new merchandise collections, cultures and the evolving luxury market. Our respect and love for the brand creates a workplace like no other.  



Tiffany employees honor every special moment in our customer's lives and every unique gift that commemorates their milestones. This differentiating factor, known as the Tiffany Experience ( *Creating Connections, Providing Personalized Experiences and Honoring the Tiffany Legacy)* is never compromised…. and it never will be.  



We expect our employees to deliver the Tiffany Experience to each and every customer and Tiffany is committed to creating an organization that recognizes and rewards excellence in service of this promise. For us, it is a dream to be associated with a company that is forever aligned with exquisite craftsmanship, timeless design and a dedicated commitment to corporate sustainability.  



**Responsibilities:**

The Operations Coordinator takes the lead by performing all back of house operations in a Tiffany store. The Coordinator has a passion for providing excellent client service and partners with store leadership on key initiatives which supports the team and drives sales goals. The Coordinator is a key holder who acts as a manager on duty when a manager is unavailable. Duties include coordinating order fulfillment, managing inventory, coordinating client service activities, and may open and close the store.  



**Sales:** Deepen the relationship with our clients to drive lifetime loyalty and spend. Carry out operations and sales support functions to support the store in consistently achieving or exceeding monthly, quarterly and annual store sales plan. Capture customer data during interactions to cultivate new and existing customers. Act as Guest Experience Manager, key holder, and carryout opening and closing procedures in the absence of a manager. Drive business through key product pillars.  



**Service:** Elevate in store experience by consistently delivering memorable moments. Demonstrate passion as a Tiffany brand ambassador, providing the Tiffany Touch during every client interaction. Demonstrate Client Experience Behaviors identified within the TEI program (Voice of Client Survey). Execute best practices by optimizing hospitality and store amenities to create unique experiences and take action on TEI performance and client feedback. Resolve client and employee concerns utilizing judgment and thorough knowledge of policy, procedure and practice.  



**Operational Excellence:** Provide exceptional operational support to drive sales and service. Execute daily tasks such as order fulfillment, shipping, receiving and replenishment, cleaning jewelry, transferring merchandise, taking in jewelry repairs and cleaning merchandise, following company operational policies and procedures. Ensure compliance with all internal control procedures and maintain inventory accuracy. Partner and communicate effectively with Sales Professionals, Management and clients to respond and follow up to requests quickly and accurately. Support Company operations efficiency objectives by ensuring all activities maximize productivity and by providing feedback on process changes through appropriate channels. Assist management in coordinating work and coaching team members to improve performance when acting as manager on duty. Takes the lead, partnering with the operations professional to ensure operational excellence in all tasks.  



**Qualifications:**

Required Qualifications:


* 2\-3 years of prior retail experience in retail operations with comprehensive knowledge of merchandising, client service, administration and shipping.
* Strong Analytical skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Word and Excel.
* Ability to work retail store hours as necessary, including nights, weekends and holidays.
* Organized and detail oriented.
* Flexibility to perform different tasks based on day\-to\-day business needs.
* Must have authorization to work in the United States or in the country where the position is based.

Preferred Qualifications:


* A college/university degree.
Graduate Gemologist degree or previous Gemological Institute of America (GIA) course work.  
* 

Illinois Wage Transparency Disclosure\-$24\.65\-$29\.00


***TIFFANY \& CO.***
**MAISON**
-------------------------------

Founded in 1837 by Charles Lewis Tiffany in New York City, Tiffany \& Co. is one of the world’s most prestigious houses for jewelry and accessories. Love has been the driving force of Tiffany \& Co. since its inception, uniting the jeweler’s core values of inventiveness, craft and joy in designs that endure across generations.
  

As a global pioneer in the art of fine jewelry, Tiffany has spent almost two centuries perfecting its craft and setting benchmarks within the industry. It is through this unwavering vow to excellence and expertise, to heritage and innovation, to optimism and possibility that Tiffany continues its legacy, creating designs that inspire people to express and celebrate the many facets of love.

new_jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (Chicago)
new_jobs.description:
**Sales Development Representative (Chicago)**

  

You don't pay us. We pay you.


SV Academy is hiring Sales Development Representatives. This is a full\-time job that includes free sales training, a 90\-day paid Residency at a partner company, and a clear path to a long\-term sales role at one of our 400\+ partner companies.


Cohorts begin every week and are limited to 25 Residents. Apply early to be considered for the next available start date.


Compensation

* **Days 1–10** — Free sales training. No tuition, no fee, no debt. Live, instructor\-led training on Zoom, Monday through Thursday, 6–9 pm (ET or PT).
* **Days 11–100** — Paid Residency. $2,500/month base \+ 100% of the commissions you earn. You'll be a W\-2 employee of SV Academy, embedded at a partner company.
* **Day 100 onward** — Transfer to the partner's payroll. $50k \- $85k in total annual compensation (base \+ commission). Full health, dental, vision, and retirement benefits begin the day you transfer to the partner.


No tuition. No loans. No deferred\-income agreement.


We're paid out of the hiring budget the partner was already going to spend — which means our incentive is to make you successful in the role!

**How the 100 Days Work**

**Days 1–10** — Free sales training. Ten days of live, instructor\-led training. Monday through Thursday, 6–9 pm (ET or PT), on Zoom. No cost to you. You'll learn the fundamentals of B2B sales: outbound calls, email and LinkedIn outreach, objection handling, qualification, CRM and sales engagement tools (Salesforce or HubSpot, Outreach or Salesloft, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).

**Days 11–100** — Paid Residency at a partner company. You'll work full\-time at one of our partner companies as a W\-2 employee of SV Academy. Real sales work: outbound prospecting via phone, email, and LinkedIn; qualifying inbound leads; scheduling discovery meetings for Account Executives. You'll get daily coaching from an SV Academy mentor and from the partner's sales leadership.

**Day 100** — Transfer to the partner. Successful Residents transfer directly onto the partner's payroll at the compensation above, with full benefits starting that day.

**About SV Academy**


Since 2017, we've placed more than 6,000 people into full\-time tech sales careers and worked with 400\+ employer partners across SaaS, AI, fintech, cybersecurity, and other high\-growth verticals.


Led by CEO Michael Colonnese, a 15\+ year veteran of workforce development focused on building debt\-free pathways into tech careers.


Our partners pay us. You don't. That's the entire business model.

**Who Tends to Succeed Here**


No prior sales experience required. We hire people who are:

* Competitive and motivated by clear goals
* Comfortable on the phone, including cold calls
* Coachable — you take feedback and act on it
* Resilient — sales involves rejection, and you can keep going
* Strong written and spoken communicators


If you've worked in retail, hospitality, customer service, fundraising, fitness instruction, teaching, or any role where you spent your day talking to people and meeting goals — you already have the foundation to be excellent at this.

**What Happens After You Apply**

* Apply through this posting — takes about 3 minutes.
* We respond within 2 business days. If you're a fit, we'll set up a 20\-minute intro call.
* Cohort placement. If you move forward, we'll match you with a partner company and a start date. Cohorts begin every Monday and are limited to 25 Residents — apply early for priority consideration.


Apply today. The next cohort starts soon and spots fill on a first\-reviewed basis.

 **Requirements**  

  

Required Qualifications:* English proficiency sufficient for professional work communication
* Permanently authorized to work in the United States without need for sponsorship

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Completed Bachelors degree
* Experience in a customer\-facing role such as retail, hospitality, customer support, fundraising, or account management
* Experience in a goal\-driven role with measurable targets (quotas, KPIs, bookings, revenue, or activity metrics)
* Ability to attend evening sessions during the 2\-week bootcamp
* Confident and engaging communicator
* Excited by ambitious goals and motivated by a high\-performance environment

  

**Benefits**  

* Comprehensive 2\-week online bootcamp training
* Paid 3\-month residency with an employer partner
* Hybrid work environment
* Exposure to leading technology companies and sales teams
* Professional development and mentorship opportunities
* Supportive community and network of peers
